notes.observation: The first source extraction unit begins by repeating the chapter title 'தந்தையின் துணிவு'.
notes.translation_action: Represent the heading in title metadata and do not translate the extraction repeat as body prose.

notes.observation: The source breaks the word across extraction units as 'கேட்க-' followed by 'லாம்'.
notes.translation_action: Read as the continuous word 'கேட்கலாம்' in context and record the intervention rather than treating the hyphen as authorial punctuation.

notes.observation: A later extraction boundary ends with 'விடு-' and continues as 'மல்லவா?' in the following unit.
notes.translation_action: Read as the continuous rhetorical form 'விடுமல்லவா?' and preserve extraction-unit traceability.

notes.observation: The orphan-infant passage contains the extracted question 'அதன் வயிற்றுப் பசியை பார் போக்குவது? எப்படிப் போக்குவது?'. The older page-level witness for page 22 reproduces the same 'பார்', so it does not resolve the anomalous token. In context, the sentence asks who is to relieve the infant's hunger and how.
notes.translation_action: Translate the contextual question as 'Who was to relieve that hunger? How was it to be relieved?' and keep the source intervention disclosed. Do not alter the read-only source.

notes.observation: Page 24 reads 'ஆனால் அவ்ளோ, கள்ளக் காதலர்களில் ஒருவனோடு...'. Syntax and narrative context require the feminine contrast functioning as 'அவளோ'. The secondary page-level witness reproduces the same extracted form.
notes.translation_action: Render the contextual feminine sense ('yet she...') while retaining this note; do not silently treat the digital source as clean.

notes.observation: Page 25 reads 'அவன்பால் விழுந்த காமுகர்கள்' although the surrounding sentence identifies the female heroine as the person attracting the lovers. The page-level witness also reproduces 'அவன்பால்'.
notes.translation_action: Use the contextually coherent feminine referent ('the lovers who fell for her') and disclose the source-form/gender mismatch here.

notes.observation: Narrative prose, song quotations and page joins do not correspond reliably to the JSON element boundaries.
notes.translation_action: Reconstruct literary prose/verse units from syntax and form; record the mapping in later alignment metadata.

notes.observation: The chapter embeds satirical songs attributed to Muthuvelar. They function as evidence of his courage and social criticism, not as detachable decoration.
notes.translation_action: Translate them as verse/song, preserving speaker, attack, imagery and satire; do not flatten them into prose summary.

notes.observation: The long ஏலேலோ song contains 'போகசாலை'. An external Tamil Digital Library architectural source (TVA_BOK_0012940, p. 50) explicitly glosses 'போகசாலை' as 'சயன சாலை', supporting the sense sleeping hall/bedchamber.
notes.translation_action: Correct T1's over-interpretive 'pleasure-house' to a sleeping-quarters/bedchamber rendering.

notes.observation: The line 'அவரோடு ஊடியும் கலந்துமே வந்தேன்' uses 'ஊடல்' in its established lovers' sense: a small love-quarrel / feigned sulking before reunion.
notes.translation_action: Replace T1's generic 'dallied' with a rendering that preserves the lovers' quarrel followed by joining/reunion.

notes.observation: The page-level witness for page 24 reproduces 'தன் வீட்டுத் தரகுமூட்டை / தலைமேலிருந்தும்'. The compound 'தரகுமூட்டை' remains insufficiently secure semantically from the available text witnesses.
notes.translation_action: Do not preserve T1's confident paraphrase 'burdens of your own household'. Retain the Tamil compound transliterated in the provisional English line pending a stronger print/image witness or an explicit editorial decision.

notes.observation: The page-level witness for page 24 also reproduces 'அவசரமாய் முந்தானையால் / கூட்டியே நின்று'. The words themselves are legible in the digital witness, but the exact object/syntactic force of 'கூட்டியே' with 'முந்தானையால்' remains unclear.
notes.translation_action: Render conservatively without supplying an unexpressed object; keep the chapter on source hold until a stronger witness or explicit editorial decision resolves the line.

notes.observation: The chapter relies on culturally loaded terms and images such as தாலி, பள்ளயம், குலவிளக்கு, குலதெய்வம், விபூதி, மாந்திரீகர், இடும்பன் சாமி and agricultural implements.
notes.translation_action: Retain or lightly gloss terms where English substitution would erase cultural function. 'பள்ளயம்' is treated as a ritual food offering/spread rather than a generic ceremony. Do not over-explain inside Kalaignar's prose.

notes.observation: The chapter repeatedly moves among bereavement, village portraiture, social criticism, devotion/traditional healing, agricultural detail, family affection and humour.
notes.translation_action: Do not normalise the whole chapter into one solemn or academic register. Preserve the sudden tonal turns and punchlines.

notes.observation: The final two source extraction units are Wikisource maintenance notices stating that duplicate pages should not be proofread and linking to page 26 / page 27. They are editorial interface/source-management text, not Kalaignar's memoir.
notes.translation_action: Exclude both units from the literary English translation. Their exclusion remains explicitly recorded here.
